name: table
title: Data table
description: Dense data table with a caption, sortable headers, row links and a scroll region.

a11y.pattern: Native <table> with <caption>, th scope=col, aria-sort and a focusable scroll region
keyboard: Reaches the scroll region, sort buttons and row links in DOM order
Activates a sort button, or the row header toggle of a selectable row
Scroll the region when it has focus
No tab stop on the wrapper: a table that never overflows is not a scroll region
aria: <caption> names the table; the region is labelled by it
aria-sort="ascending|descending" on the sorted header only
Selected row: aria-current="true" on its link, or a visually hidden "Selected" for rows without a link
A polite live region announces "Sorted by <column>, ascending"
Selectable row: the row header is a <button aria-pressed="true|false"> named by the row header text; the pressed row is the selected one
scroll=false: no role=region, no aria-labelledby and no tabindex on the wrapper
a11y.notes: No <tr onClick>: the row link is a real anchor stretched over the row. Other links or buttons in the row stay clickable. The caller sorts the rows (sortRows helper provided). layout=fixed with per-column width keeps column widths stable; use scroll=false only when the table never overflows (its content is clipped otherwise).
